//: FRAGMENT fixture for the canonical KPI TILE — the `.pa-kpi-tile` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Kpi.kpi_tile/1`, svelte `display/KpiTerminalTile.svelte`). A pa-kpi-tile is one dense KPI cell used inside a `.pa-kpi-terminal__grid` (or standalone via `--standalone`): a head row (`__head` with `__id` + `__status`), an uppercase `__label`, a focal value group (`__values` > `__value` > `__num`/`__unit`), a previous-period `__prev` row (bare `prev <value>` span + `__delta` chip), a sparkline `__spark` SVG, and an optional hover detail popover. SCOPE = the tile's own structural markup across the simple/sentiment states where BOTH wrappers agree. TWO ACKNOWLEDGED DIVERGENCES drive the scenario design (documented, NOT fixed in either wrapper): (1) svelte ALWAYS emits `.pa-kpi-tile__label` and `.pa-kpi-tile__values` (even empty), while keen renders them only when their data is present — so EVERY scenario supplies both labelText AND valueText, making the two wrappers emit identical label + values. (2) svelte wraps the chart slot in a `<div style="display:contents">` host (for the kpiSparklineDots action) while keen renders the chart SVG directly — so NO scenario exercises the chart slot; the `.pa-kpi-tile__spark` SVG is DEFERRED (fixture-ref) to kpi-sparkline, which produces it. The hover detail popover (`.pa-kpi-detail*`) is a SEPARATE block (distinct hyphen-joined `pa-kpi-detail`, not a `pa-kpi-tile__*` element) emitted by the sibling kpi_detail/1 — none of these scenarios set detailTitleText, so the popover never renders, and it is deferred (fixture-ref) to kpi-detail. Authored from snippets/kpi.html (terminal tile, L239-261) + _kpi-terminal.scss / _kpi-base.scss.

propsVocabulary.variant: spark-direction sentiment cascade on the block — `pa-kpi-tile--{variant}` (up-strong/up/flat/down/down-strong); colours the sparkline via currentColor. svelte variant; keen variant (dasherizes up_strong->up-strong).
propsVocabulary.standalone: `pa-kpi-tile--standalone` — full border + card bg + bottom margin for a tile OUTSIDE a `__grid`. svelte isStandalone; keen is_standalone. bool.
propsVocabulary.idText: tertiary identifier caption in the head row — `__id` span. svelte idText; keen id_text. Head row renders when idText and/or statusText is present.
propsVocabulary.statusText: status pill text (e.g. WARN/GOOD) — `__status` span. svelte statusText; keen status_text.
propsVocabulary.statusVariant: status pill variant — `__status--{variant}` (good/warn/neutral). svelte statusVariant; keen status_variant.
propsVocabulary.labelText: uppercase metric name — `__label`. svelte labelText; keen label_text. (Divergence: svelte always emits the __label div; keen only when set — every scenario sets it.)
propsVocabulary.valuePrefix: currency/scale prefix ($,¥) — leading `__unit` span inside `__value`. svelte valuePrefix; keen prefix_text.
propsVocabulary.valueText: focal number — `__num`. svelte valueText; keen value_text. (Divergence: svelte always emits the __values div; keen only when a value part is set — every scenario sets it.)
propsVocabulary.valueUnit: trailing unit affix (%,K) — trailing `__unit` span inside `__value`. svelte valueUnit; keen unit_text.
propsVocabulary.valueVariant: sentiment tint on the focal value — `__value--{variant}` (very-positive/positive/neutral/negative/very-negative). svelte valueVariant; keen value_variant.
propsVocabulary.previousValueText: bare previous value — rendered as `prev <value>` in a plain `<span>` inside `__prev`. svelte previousValueText; keen previous_value_text. The __prev row renders when previousValueText and/or deltaText is present.
propsVocabulary.deltaText: bottom-row Δ% chip text (caller supplies the arrow) — `__delta`. svelte deltaText; keen delta_text.
propsVocabulary.deltaVariant: sentiment tint on the delta chip — `__delta--{variant}` (same 5-value sentiment scale as valueVariant). svelte deltaVariant; keen delta_variant.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the tile shell (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: Element order inside `.pa-kpi-tile`: `__head` (when id/status) → `__label` → `__values` > `__value` > [prefix __unit] __num [unit __unit] → `__prev` (plain prev span + `__delta` chip) → `__spark` (deferred, not exercised). The `__prev` baseline is a BARE `<span>` (no element class) holding the literal text `prev <value>`. Every scenario sets labelText + valueText so svelte's always-rendered __label/__values match keen's conditional ones. The chart slot is never exercised (svelte wraps it in a display:contents host; keen renders direct). No detailTitleText → no popover. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

deferred.//: `.pa-kpi-tile__spark` is the sparkline SVG — svelte wraps the chart slot in a `<div style="display:contents">` host while keen renders the SVG directly, so the chart slot is NOT exercised here; the spark SVG is produced by the kpi_sparkline/1 convenience component and is fixture-verified against kpi-sparkline. The `.pa-kpi-detail*` popover is a SEPARATE block (distinct hyphen-joined `pa-kpi-detail`, not a `pa-kpi-tile__*` element) emitted by the sibling kpi_detail/1 only when detailTitleText (or a detail slot) is set — no scenario sets it, so it never renders; verified against kpi-detail. Because `pa-kpi-detail*` is its own block it is NOT caught by capability axis-1's `pa-kpi-tile__*` element reverse-check, but a fixture-ref is still authored to document the ownership.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-tile(--|__)'). Block modifiers: --up-strong/--up/--flat/--down/--down-strong (produced by `variant`) + --standalone (produced by `standalone`). Element classes: __head/__id/__status(+good/warn/neutral)/__label/__values/__value(+5 sentiment)/__num/__unit/__prev/__delta(+5 sentiment) all claimed by features and/or exercised by goldens (the BASE `__delta` class has NO standalone rule in main.css — only `__delta--*` is styled, produced by deltaVariant — so deltaText is produces:null and the base class is covered by the goldens that render it); __spark is deferred (fixture-ref kpi-sparkline). produces:null = structural/native (no pa-kpi-tile modifier).
